apps.localizedDescription: A free and open-source PlayStation 2 (PS2) emulator based on PCSX2, with native ARM64 JIT recompilers. Play PS2 games on your phone, PC, or gaming handheld.

versions.localizedDescription:
Automated nightly build for community testing (unsigned).

Every download is named `ARMSX2-nightly-DATE-COMMIT-PLATFORM`, so builds
from different nights stay distinguishable after you have downloaded them.

- macOS arm64: macOS-arm64.tar.xz
- Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-4K-pages.AppImage on most distros, or the 16K one on Asahi Linux and other Apple Silicon kernels (run getconf PAGESIZE if unsure)
- Windows arm64: Windows-arm64.zip
- RetroArch on Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-libretro-core.tar.zst, a 4K-page build
- Bare-display kmsdrm handhelds: Linux-arm64-SDL-handheld.tar.zst, a 4K-page build (Rocknix and Batocera run compositors, so use the Qt AppImage there instead)
- Android: Android-arm64.apk (installs as ARMSX2 Nightly, alongside the stable app)
- iOS: iOS-arm64.ipa, unsigned, sideload it (installs as ARMSX2 Nightly, alongside the stable app)

Coming from an old nightly? Nightlies are now a separate app, ARMSX2 Nightly, next to stable.

- Android: stable cannot install over an old nightly. Back up your saves and memory cards, uninstall the old nightly, then install the stable APK.
- iOS: your old nightly is the ARMSX2 iOS app and still has your saves. Copy them into ARMSX2 Nightly with the Files app.

## What's new
- iOS: move the cheats list sections out of the view body
- iOS: compile the Swift UI at -Onone in Debug
- iOS: build the core once with Ninja, outside the app project
- iOS: use the helpers that already exist instead of copies
- iOS: trim the logs to what a bug report needs
- iOS: trim the bridge to what Swift calls
- iOS: reconnect two features that lost their caller
- iOS: delete dead Swift code
- iOS: read Haptic Feedback on every rumble, not once a session
- iOS: get the Mac Catalyst build working again
- iOS: move the app out of the Gradle-style app/src/main tree
- Comments: trim the comments added since 2026-09-28
- GameDB: Tekken 5's arcade entries use bilinearUpscale
- GameDB: load only once the resources folder is set
- OSD: ARMSX2 2.9 on Android
- EE: charge MFC0 and DI 1 cycle and TLBP 3, as the console takes
- Android: translate the swap chain pre-rotation switch
- Discord: a Friends switch to show ARMSX2 instead of the game in the status
- Add quit application hotkey
- Android: regenerate the PGO profile on the EE timing source
- EE: charge the FPU accumulator writes 1 cycle, as the console takes
- EE: charge PMFHI and PMFLO 1 cycle, as the console takes
- EE: charge the MMI ALU ops 1 cycle, as the console takes
- EE: note that the SCPH-30001 times DIVU, DIVU1 and RSQRT.S as charged
- EE: charge PDIVW, PDIVUW and PDIVBW 37 cycles, as the console takes
- EE: charge RSQRT.S 13 cycles, as the SCPH-90000 takes
- EE: charge DIV.S and SQRT.S 7 cycles, as two consoles take
- EE: charge DIV, DIVU, DIV1 and DIVU1 37 cycles, as the console takes
- tests: give the EE harness's JIT leg room for slow programs
- tests: pin what both EE engines charge for each divide
- iOS: lay out OrbitKeys around iPhone Duo's fold
- iOS: keep the pause card, Per-Game and Cheats in place across a fold
- iOS: lay out the pause card and in-game panels around iPhone Duo's fold
- iOS: refit the pad to iPhone Duo's short portrait decks
- iOS: read iPhone Duo's hinge and fold, and size layouts by window
- iOS: small focus, VoiceOver and layout fixes for every device
- iOS: keep layouts in place under a text field's keyboard
- iOS: keep SDL's hidden text field from taking the keyboard
- EE: ask for the event test after MTC0 Status, EI and ERET only when it could act
- tests: pin the event test MTC0 Status, EI and ERET schedule, and where each engine takes the interrupt
- eerunner: --threadperf-frontend counts the CPU thread's front-end events in a liverun
- EE rec: memory-op addresses and store values read from where they live
- EE rec: branch-free SDL/SDR on the fastmem path
- EE rec: no cpuRegs.branch bracket around a fastmem memory op in a delay slot

Full changelog: https://github.com/ARMSX2/ARMSX2/compare/nightly-20261028...aa52a1fdc7cd03fb02bd404ebaa9940944e7fc60
